problem: We will put it on your phone ourselves
action: The dealer and a younger staff member stand shoulder to shoulder at the office counter, both looking down at a single mobile phone the dealer is holding. The younger one is pointing at it. Both are relaxed and slightly amused — this is easy, and neither of them is struggling.
lighting: Warm friendly indoor daylight, both faces well lit, soft background. Open and unintimidating.
camera: Chest-up two-shot, heads close together in the upper half of the vertical frame, the phone in the lower third held up between them. Sharp on both. 35mm.
detail: The phone screen is COMPLETELY DARK and blank — no interface, no app, no text, no icons, no glow. A real screen is composited in afterwards. No logos on clothing. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Nobody here is going to be made to feel stupid.
motion: The younger one's pointing finger moves slightly. The dealer's head tilts a fraction towards the phone. A slow push in. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.
